title: Kiritani Haruka — Producer Studies〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... Channel analytics should be in... This tab.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good, we're gradually receiving more viewers. We seem to be reaching a new demographic, which...
<Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, I came over because I heard you were working on stream ideas. Can I watch what you're doing?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I was actually just going through the analytics data for our channel.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Analytics data?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. For example...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm currently looking at the data for the archived stream we did the other day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here's the total view count, and this tells you at what times people are watching. It even shows viewer demographics.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's incredible...!
So, you use this data to come up with your next ideas?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For our next stream, I'd like to do something that's geared towards new viewers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My plan for the near term is to keep an eye on the data regarding those people.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey, can I help you analyze this data...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes! After hearing you explain everything, Haruka, I feel like trying my hand at it.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate it, since a fresh set of eyes might see something I don't.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's start by looking at the new age groups we've been reaching. We'll compare against the ages of the people who watched our old videos, and...
The next day
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's get today's meeting started.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to begin by discussing our next stream, so if you all don't mind taking a look at my proposal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Easy listening for our viewers.
Chill Radio brought to you by MORE MORE JUMP!”...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
The plan is to put on a more relaxing radio program in order to give our listeners a chance to unwind for the day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, we've never done anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But where'd this “Chill Radio” idea come from?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Before coming up with this idea, I went through the data for our archived streams in order to identify the demographics of our viewers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We seem to be drawing a lot more people in their thirties than before. Not only that, they tend to watch our videos pretty late in the evening.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's interesting. Does that mean they're watching our videos before they go to bed...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I thought we could do something that people watching late at night would enjoy. That's where a chill radio program comes in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for what we'd actually talk about on it, I'd like for us to discuss that now. Would that be alright...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I think it's a wonderful idea.
Putting on a different radio program compared to normal does seem like a good way to show a new side of ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I agree! I also like to unwind while listening to late-night radio programs, so I'd love to do one myself!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm also in, since this idea seems to have the best of both worlds. It'll be fun for our existing fans and meets the needs of a key demographic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
In that case, let's continue planning this out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Still, this is a great idea. Nice work, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, Miku and I came up with this idea together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. She actually came up with all these different ideas that I never would've, so her help ended up being enormous.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, since you and Miku worked so hard to come up with this idea, we need to do our best to turn it into a good stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's start by discussing what we're gonna talk about during it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm glad they like this “Chill Radio” idea.
I really need to thank Miku again later.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we're about to discuss the meat of this proposal...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (In order to get more people to come back and watch more of our streams...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We need to make sure our radio program is a good one.)
